basic_info.description: Perfectly situated in the heart of Pacific Heights, 2957 Jackson Street is a rare townhouse style condominium that offers the privacy, scale, and livability of a single-family home across three thoughtfully designed levels. This beautifully reimagined residence features three bedrooms, two and a half baths, and a dedicated lower level office - an ideal floor plan for today's modern lifestyle. The newly remodeled kitchen and baths showcase clean, contemporary finishes, while the grand bedroom level impresses with soaring ceilings and a dramatic skylight that floods the home with natural light. The expansive primary suite offers custom built-ins and a luxurious en-suite bath with all-new fixtures and a soaking tub. Two additional spacious bedrooms and in-unit laundry complete the perfect family friendly layout. Additional highlights include one-car deeded garage parking with interior access, and a prime Pacific Heights location near Lafayette and Alta Plaza Parks, acclaimed schools, and Sacramento and Fillmore Street boutiques and cafes. 2957 Jackson blends classic San Francisco charm with contemporary comfort - an exceptional opportunity in one of the city's most sought-after enclaves.
